description.stringValue: Wide, generous bowl thrown on the wheel with a hand-mixed celadon glaze. Perfect for salads, pasta, or as a stunning centerpiece. Approx. 9" diameter.
A tall, slender bottle vase with a natural terracotta-to-ash gradient glaze. Striking alone or with dried stems. Approx. 14" tall.
A matched pair of handthrown mugs with a warm speckled cream glaze and sturdy pulled handles. Holds 12 oz. Dishwasher safe and super good.
